title: The Day of the Open Windows
skyStory: The moon has scuttled sideways into Cancer, the crab, carrying its thirteen percent of light like a shell it is not quite ready to leave. Cancer is the homebody of the zodiac and it wants every window in the hemisphere thrown open to let the winter out. Mars volunteers to do the heavy lifting. Saturn reminds everyone that screens exist for a reason.

reading: Today the cabin wants airing out. Open a window you haven't touched since October and let the stale winter air drift out like an old ghost that finally got the hint. The house will sound different afterward: birds, a lawnmower two streets over, a wind chime that has clearly never been tuned.

Home energy is strong, and so is the urge to fix everything inside it. Fix one hinge. One. The [[Four of Wands]] says the cabin is already a place worth coming back to, squeak and all. Tonight, sit somewhere you never sit in your own home and look at it the way a visitor would.
joel.mission: Open the most stubborn window in your home and leave it open for at least one full hour.
joel.omen: A wind chime ringing when you can't feel any breeze. Good news is on its way home to you.

reading: The crab moon is your friend today. It's patient, it protects what matters, and it walks sideways around obstacles instead of through them. You will too, all day, and everybody will wonder how you got where you are so fast.

Around 3:30 someone will lean on you for comfort, the steady-shoulder kind. Give it, of course. Then let them give something back, even if it's only a compliment you'd normally deflect. Today the mother of pearl wants you to say thank you and stop there. No but, no actually. Just thank you.
nancy.mission: Accept the next compliment you get with only the words thank you, then sip something to stop yourself adding more.
nancy.omen: A crab drawn in chalk on a sidewalk, walking sideways and grinning. You will get around today's obstacle without going through it.

together.text: Each of you choose one corner of your home to declare officially sunny, even if it's a windowsill and a cushion. Send a photo. These are now embassies. When either of you needs a moment, go stand in your embassy and think of the other one.
